required_outputs_scope: verifier-internal assembly; agents submit stage_required_outputs in each stage directory listed in instruction.md

results_jsonl.record_id_rule: record_id must be a non-empty string and globally unique across all submitted stages; duplicate IDs are reported with both locations and all conflicting rows are locally ineligible.

field_types.effect: finite number or null when status is not_estimable/not_observable

R_candidate_forms: separate material rows with the same entity_id and explicit A/B/C scope prefixes
one aggregate row whose scope or coverage.materials explicitly lists the covered materials and whose coverage contains auditable rank-sensitivity bounds

R_candidate_optional_fields.coverage.materials: array containing A, B, and/or C

rules: each gene-role pair is unique within one annotation record
a supporting marker contributes annotation evidence only when effect is positive, pct_in exceeds pct_out, and q_value is at most 0.10
marker names without auditable marker_statistics can contribute only bounded partial annotation evidence; quantitative marker_statistics are required for full marker credit

nomination_limits.policy: Annotation, result, and conclusion records are ordered nominations: within each stage and record_type, rows beyond the public limit are ignored locally. Background hypothesis tables belong in the bounded evidence bundle, not results.jsonl. An overflow row cannot earn points, but overflow does not invalidate retained nominations, other record types, or other stages.

results_jsonl.null_rule: Use JSON null for unavailable numeric values and explain the reason in notes.

rules: one row represents one hypothesis in one multiple-testing family
coverage may be a numeric independent-unit count or a JSON object containing paired_patients or n_units
for manifest mode complete, include every observable, unobservable, and non-estimable family member exactly once
for manifest mode compact, include only nominated members plus the deterministic audit subset; do not submit the remaining family as a large table
a compact observable row reports its one-based rank in the full raw-P family and a BH tail witness whose rank and raw P reproduce the submitted q_value
record_id is the evidence identifier cited by nominated result records; conclusion records are linked to results by their structured scientific fields
record_id must reference a family member in test_families.csv.gz
scientific result records must cite the upstream record_id values used as evidence; an uncited result cannot inherit method validity
include independent-unit values for every family member cited by a result

also include the deterministic audit subset consisting of at most 64 family members with the smallest SHA256 of stage|analysis_type|scope|entity_id; include all members when the family has 64 or fewer
do not expand the remaining family members into process rows
one row represents one independent-unit value used by the reported test
value_role distinguishes outcome, predictor, covariate, numerator, denominator, or component values when a test needs more than one value per unit
feature_id identifies a gene, complex subunit, programme member, or omitted sensitivity member when applicable
stratum_id identifies a state, compartment, cell line, method, or sensitivity stratum when applicable

Use stable pipe-delimited entity_id values for stratified families: pathway scope|library|term; TF scope|regulon, or scope|endpoint|regulon for endpoint coupling; LIANA receiver-or-family|source-if-defined|ligand_complex|receptor_complex. Use the same entity_id in both files.
required once for every pathway family manifest entry and omitted for non-pathway entries

contains only the union of the top 32, bottom 32, and 64 features with the smallest hexadecimal SHA256 of the exact case-sensitive UTF-8 feature_id bytes in the full ranking; combine roles with a pipe when one feature belongs to multiple subsets
does not contain the full gene ranking
rank_value, effect, and statistic are finite for observable rows
rank_position is the one-based position in the full ranking
rank_feature_set_sha256 is SHA256 of the UTF-8 stream formed by exact feature_id plus newline, ordered lexicographically by feature_id
rank_order_sha256 is SHA256 of the UTF-8 stream formed by exact feature_id, a tab, one-based integer rank_position, and newline, ordered by rank_position
the same audit may be reused as a ZIP member only by copying it to a unique member name for each independently scoreable family entry

transport_limit_enforcement.scope: per stage evidence bundle and independently declared family
transport_limit_enforcement.behavior: The verifier checks ZIP metadata before opening a declared member. An oversized bundle is skipped for that stage; an oversized, duplicate, missing, unsafe, or cumulative-over-budget declared member makes only its family ineligible. Other declared families and stages remain scoreable.
transport_limit_enforcement.declared_total_definition: The total is computed from unique manifest-referenced members only; undeclared archive members are never opened or counted.

rules: manifest.json lists one independently scoreable family per entry
max_families applies independently to each stage, analysis_type, and scope component; it is not a whole-bundle family limit

each entry contains family_key, stage, analysis_type, scope, family_id, family_member, process_member, family_submission_mode, full_family_size, observable_family_size, family_entity_set_sha256, family_p_order_sha256, and audit_selection_rule
family_submission_mode is complete or compact; compact uses sha256_smallest_64_plus_nominated and submits at most 80 family rows
a pathway entry additionally contains rank_audit_member, rank_feature_count, rank_feature_set_sha256, and rank_order_sha256
family_member uses the test-family columns, process_member uses the process-value columns, and pathway rank_audit_member uses the compact rank-audit columns
use unique safe relative member names; a SHA256-derived filename is recommended
an entry that exceeds its declared byte or row budget is not opened or scored; other entries remain scoreable

artifact_limits.allowed_top_level_outputs_scope: each stage directory after verifier assembly; final_chain_report is the only additional chain-level artifact

requirements: summarize the main evidence from each completed stage
state alternative explanations and evidence limits
distinguish observation, association, experimental response, and causality

code.requirement: Provide runnable code that reconstructs the submitted machine-readable results from the task inputs.
